items.title: 迪拜Al Maktoum国际机场新增约565亿迪拉姆工程授标
items.title_en: Dubai awards approximately AED56.5 billion in new Al Maktoum International Airport contracts
items.sector: 机场基础设施与建筑工程
items.category: 新一轮工程合同已授予
items.summary: 迪拜宣布Al Maktoum国际机场新一轮工程合同授标，合计约565亿迪拉姆，覆盖西航站楼及部分候机廊地下结构、2号和3号候机廊上部建筑、交通系统及主要电力设施等多个工程包。这是多项合同总额，并非单一总包合同。
items.summary_en: Dubai announced a further round of Al Maktoum International Airport construction contracts totalling about AED56.5 billion, spanning substructure, concourse superstructure and major transport and electrical systems. This is a combined value across packages, not a single contract.
items.why_it_matters: 机场土建、机电设备、钢结构、建筑劳务、运输和工程分包。
items.why_it_matters_en: Dubai announced a further round of Al Maktoum International Airport construction contracts totalling about AED56.5 billion, spanning substructure, concourse superstructure and major transport and electrical systems. This is a combined value across packages, not a single contract.

items.title: Nakheel授予Ginco逾14亿迪拉姆合同，建设Palm Jebel Ali别墅
items.title_en: Nakheel awards Ginco over AED1.4 billion to build 176 Palm Jebel Ali villas
items.sector: 住宅房地产与建筑承包
items.summary: Nakheel授予Ginco General Contracting LLC价值逾14亿迪拉姆的主施工合同，在Palm Jebel Ali四个棕榈叶片区域建设176栋别墅，包括128栋Beach Villas和48栋Coral Villas，涵盖土建、建筑、机电、室内精装修和外部工程，施工期预计从开工起24个月。
items.summary_en: Nakheel awarded Ginco General Contracting LLC a main construction contract worth over AED1.4 billion to deliver 176 villas on Palm Jebel Ali, comprising 128 Beach Villas and 48 Coral Villas. Works span civil, MEP, fit-out and external construction over an expected 24 months from commencement.
items.why_it_matters: 别墅施工劳务、精装修、建筑材料、机电、景观与配套供应。
items.why_it_matters_en: Nakheel awarded Ginco General Contracting LLC a main construction contract worth over AED1.4 billion to deliver 176 villas on Palm Jebel Ali, comprising 128 Beach Villas and 48 Coral Villas. Works span civil, MEP, fit-out and external construction over an expected 24 months from commencement.

items.title: 迪拜工业4.0计划支持超过100家工厂，发现逾30亿迪拉姆潜在增长机会
items.title_en: Dubai Industry 4.0 Boost Programme identifies more than AED3 billion in potential factory revenue gains
items.summary: 迪拜经济与旅游部Industry 4.0 Boost Programme支持七个行业的100多家工厂，评估自动化和生产力机会，估算工厂收入潜在增加约31亿迪拉姆。该数额为潜在增收估算，不是已实现营业收入或政府投资。
items.summary_en: Dubai's Industry 4.0 Boost Programme has assessed more than 100 factories across seven sectors. Potential additional factory revenue was estimated at about AED3.1 billion, not realised revenue or committed public funding.
items.why_it_matters: 工厂自动化、ERP、工业AI、系统集成、设备与技术服务。

items.title: Salik与A.R.M. Holding签署协议，扩展智慧停车支付服务
items.title_en: Salik and A.R.M. Holding sign agreement for smart parking payments in Dubai
items.summary: Salik与A.R.M. Holding签署智慧停车支付服务协议，计划在迪拜Across H、Port Saeed及Sheikh Zayed Road相关购物中心等共六处地点推广服务，预计涉及约1000个停车位，最终范围仍待双方确认。这是停车支付服务合作，不是新停车场工程。
items.summary_en: Salik signed a smart parking payment service agreement with A.R.M. Holding covering six Dubai locations and expected to involve approximately 1,000 spaces, subject to final scope. It is a service agreement, not new parking construction.
items.why_it_matters: 智慧停车、物业运营、自动支付系统、商业设施管理。

items.title: 阿联酋Future 100开放企业申请，推动新经济企业融资和市场拓展
items.title_en: UAE Future 100 opens applications for new-economy SMEs and startups
items.summary: 阿联酋经济与旅游部公布2026年度Future 100计划新一轮申请详情，面向17个未来经济行业的初创企业和中小企业。该计划旨在帮助入选企业获取成长支持、投资对接与市场拓展资源；申请开放不代表企业已经获得融资。
items.summary_en: The UAE Ministry of Economy and Tourism opened applications for the 2026 Future 100 initiative, supporting startups and SMEs across 17 future-economy sectors through recognition and access to growth and investor networks. Applications do not constitute awarded funding.
items.why_it_matters: 创新企业客户、数字服务、跨境市场拓展及企业融资合作。

items.title: 阿曼500MW Al Kamil太阳能项目进入场地施工阶段
items.title_en: Oman’s 500MW Al Kamil Solar IPP begins site levelling and preparatory works
items.category: 场地平整和准备工程开始
items.summary: 阿曼500MW Al Kamil I太阳能独立发电项目启动场地平整和前期施工，项目由Al Kamil Solar Power Company实施，EPC承包商为中国Shanxi Installation Group，计划2027年第三季度商业运营。11月27日报道的是此前举行开工仪式后的进展，不是当日新增授标。
items.summary_en: Site levelling and preparatory works have begun on Oman's 500MW Al Kamil I Solar IPP. China's Shanxi Installation Group is the EPC contractor, and commercial operations are targeted for Q3 2027. The report describes project progress, not a newly awarded EPC contract.
items.why_it_matters: 中国EPC供应链、光伏组件、工程劳务、电气设备和运维服务。

items.title: 阿曼与日本讨论扩大绿氢、先进制造与科技投资合作
items.title_en: Oman and Japan discuss cooperation in green hydrogen, advanced manufacturing and technology
items.summary: 阿曼外交部长访日期间与日本经济产业领域官员讨论绿氢、产业投资及先进技术合作。该消息属于战略合作和投资方向磋商，未披露新授标工程、签约金额或已落地投资。
items.summary_en: During an official visit to Japan, Omani and Japanese officials discussed opportunities involving green hydrogen, industrial investment and advanced technology. These were investment talks, with no new project award or investment amount announced.

items.title: 阿曼与巴西探讨化肥、矿业及粮食安全领域投资合作
items.title_en: Oman explores strategic fertiliser, mining and food security partnerships with Brazil
items.sector: 化肥、矿业与食品供应链
items.summary: 阿曼能源矿产部门代表团赴巴西与商界探讨化肥、矿产开发、能源和粮食安全领域的合作机会，包括农业物资运输走廊和产业供应链。2025年两国货物贸易额约20亿美元属于历史贸易规模，不是此次新的投资或合同。
items.summary_en: An Omani delegation explored industrial and investment cooperation with Brazil in fertilisers, minerals, energy and food security. Bilateral merchandise trade of about USD2 billion relates to 2025 and is not a newly signed project amount.
items.why_it_matters: 化肥原料、矿产品、农产品贸易、食品加工及跨境供应链。
